sources.name: USAspending.gov award search API (federal grants: FHWA 20.205, FAA AIP 20.106, BUILD/RAISE 20.933, INFRA/Mega 20.934, FTA CIG 20.500, FRA, USACE, etc.)
sources.authority: US Treasury (data reported by every federal awarding agency; recipients are state DOTs, airports, transit agencies, cities - the bodies that condemn)
sources.planned_filter: POST JSON. filters.award_type_codes=["02","03","04","05"] (grants), filters.program_numbers=[CFDA], filters.keywords=["right of way acquisition"] or ["acquire land"], filters.time_period=[{start_date,end_date}] limited to recent months; sort by "Start Date" desc. A recent Start Date with an End Date in the future = work not finished. No completed flag.
sources.sample: Award ID 693JJ22640000Y926ILRGAL320 | ILLINOIS DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION | $360,000 | 'RIGHT-OF-WAY ACQUISITION FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A SHARED USE PATH ALONG FAP 352 (IL 37/SHERIDAN RD.) FROM WADSWORTH RD. TO HENDEE RD.' | Start 2026-09-23 | county LAKE (097), IL | CFDA 20.205
sources.notes: No key, no login. Best single federal source for explicit land-acquisition money: FHWA federal-aid obligations name the ROW phase, FAA AIP grants say 'ACQUIRE LAND FOR DEVELOPMENT ... ACQUIRES 39 ACRES'. record_count is the count for keyword 'right-of-way acquisition', all grant programs, 2024-10-01 to 2026-11-17 (count endpoint: /api/v2/search/spending_by_award_count/); 'acquire land' under CFDA 20.106 returned 38 in the same window. Request 'Primary Place of Performance' to get county_code/county_name/state_code; the flat field 'Place of Performance County Code' came back None. Paginate with page / page_metadata.hasNext, limit up to 100. Docs: https://api.usaspending.gov/docs/endpoints. Search dates cannot be earlier than 2007-10-01.

sources.name: Federal Register API (notices of intent to prepare an EIS, FERC pipeline applications, STB rail construction, BLM right-of-way, EPA weekly EIS availability)
sources.authority: Office of the Federal Register / GPO; notices issued by FERC, FHWA, FRA, FTA, FAA, USACE, BLM, STB, DOE, Reclamation
sources.planned_filter: All notices are forward-looking (proposals). Use conditions[term]=<phrase>, conditions[agencies][]=<agency slug>, conditions[publication_date][gte]=YYYY-MM-DD, conditions[type][]=NOTICE, order=newest. Useful queries tested: term '"certificate of public convenience and necessity" pipeline' + agency federal-energy-regulatory-commission (112 since 2026-01-01); term '"notice of application" "Natural Gas Act"' + FERC (93); term '"notice of intent to prepare an environmental impact statement"' (56 since 2026-01-01); term 'Environmental Impact Statements; Notice of Availability' + agency environmental-protection-agency (45 weekly lists in 2026); agency surface-transportation-board + 'construction and operation' (3 since 2025).
sources.sample: 2026-14488 | 'Guardian Pipeline, LLC; Notice of Application and Establishing Intervention Deadline' | 2026-07-17 | docket_ids ['Docket No. CP26-548-000'] | FERC
sources.notes: No key. No structured state/county: location is in title/abstract/full text (fetch full_text_xml_url or raw_text_url per document and parse for county names). Add fields[]=docket_ids, fields[]=agencies, fields[]=html_url, fields[]=raw_text_url. FERC docket prefix CP = pipeline certificate (Natural Gas Act sec. 7 gives the holder eminent domain), PF = pre-filing. per_page max 1000; search results capped at 10,000 per query, so slice by date. This is the practical substitute for FERC eLibrary, which has no public API.

sources.name: EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects workbook
sources.authority: US Energy Information Administration (projects are private pipeline companies holding or seeking FERC/state certificates)
sources.planned_filter: Sheet 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects' (header on row 2). Keep Status in ('Announced','Pre-applied','Applied','Approved','On Hold'); drop 'Construction','Completed','Part Completed','Requested In Service'. Trim trailing spaces in Status. Sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)' is finished work.
sources.sample: 2028 Expansion Project | Great Basin Gas Transmission | Expansion | Status Pre-applied | In service 2028 | NV | 207 miles | 48 in | Interstate | FERC | PF26-5
sources.notes: Excel only (no CSV/JSON); it is a zip of XML so it can be read without Excel. Updated roughly quarterly (dated copies listed at https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/data.php, latest EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsOct2026.xlsx). State level only: columns 'State(s)', 'Beg_State', 'End_State', no county and no route. Also has 'Pipeline Operator Name','Miles','Pipeline Diameter (Inches)','Pipeline Type' (Interstate/Intrastate),'Authority','Crosses State Border'. Status counts on 2026-11-17: Construction 35, Applied 28, Approved 27, Announced 18, On Hold 13, Completed 12, Pre-applied 9, Part Completed 5; 67 rows have no status. Use the docket number to pull the route counties from Federal Register notices.

sources.name: USDOT TIGER/RAISE/BUILD awards 2009-2025
sources.authority: USDOT Office of the Secretary (grantees: state DOTs, cities, counties, ports, transit agencies)
sources.planned_filter: No status field. Use Year IN ('FY 2023','FY 2024','FY 2025') AND Capital_Planning = 'Capital' for projects most likely still pre-construction (278 capital awards; 449 awards of all kinds in FY2023-25).
sources.sample: FY 2009 | TIGER 1 | Alabama & Tennessee Department of Transportation | Crescent Corridor Intermodal Freight Rail Project | award 105000000 | total 224000000 | Rail | Capital
sources.notes: Hosted in the USDOT/BTS ArcGIS Online organisation. Fields also: Round, Applicant, Award_Amount__At_Time_of_Award_, Urban_Rural. State_s_ holds full state names and may hold two ('Alabama & Tennessee'). No county; point is the project location. Primary_Project_Type counts: Road 704, Transit 215, Bicycle-Pedestrian 175, Rail 112, Planning 64, Maritime 61, Port 48, Aviation 6. Sibling single-round layers with extra fields (Latitude, Longitude, Congressional_District__At_Time, Applicant_Type): https://services.arcgis.com/xOi1kZaI0eWDREZv/arcgis/rest/services/Raise25AwardsPoints/FeatureServer/0 (109) and https://services.arcgis.com/xOi1kZaI0eWDREZv/arcgis/rest/services/BUILD_US_DOT_Awards_2025_p2/FeatureServer/0 (30). Layer last edited 2025-07; FY2026 awards not yet present.

sources.name: FRA Corridor Identification and Development Program corridors (new and extended passenger rail lines)
sources.authority: Federal Railroad Administration (sponsors: state DOTs, Amtrak, rail authorities)
sources.planned_filter: Existing_or_Extension_or_New_Se IN ('New','Extension') (105 of 141 segments). Memo_Classification = 'New High Speed Rail Corridors' (12) or 'New Conventional Rail Corridors' (79) for new alignments.
sources.sample: FSP2023000111_1 | Charlotte to Kings Mountain | Existing Routes with Extensions | Rail line | Existing
sources.notes: Very early stage (planning corridors, years ahead of acquisition); lines are generalised, not surveyed alignments. No state or county attribute: intersect geometry with counties. Stops: https://services.arcgis.com/xOi1kZaI0eWDREZv/arcgis/rest/services/CorridorID_IntermediateStops/FeatureServer/0 (701 points, fields Corridor_ID_Route_Name, Label__Name_of_City_or_Code_for). Last edited 2025-09.

sources.name: Northeast Corridor Commission 2024 NEC Project Inventory
sources.authority: Northeast Corridor Commission / FRA (sponsors Amtrak, NJ Transit, MTA, SEPTA, MBTA, CTDOT, MDOT)
sources.coverage: Northeast Corridor rail line (Washington DC to Boston)
sources.planned_filter: Lifecycle_Stage IN ('Planning','Project Development','Final Design') (33 of 78). 'Construction' 38, 'No work slated' 7.
sources.sample: 1 | Frederick Douglass Tunnel Program | Amtrak | Major Backlog | Construction | TotalProjectCost1 '$5,884' (millions)
sources.notes: Also covers DC. Table 5 in the same service has numeric TotalProjectCost, CommittedFunding, FundingNeed, Latitude, Longitude. Snapshot from 2024-04; not refreshed since. No county attribute.

sources.name: FHWA Future Interstate Corridors (congressionally designated, not yet built)
sources.planned_filter: BltIntHPC = 'Needing to be built or upgraded' (160 segments; 'Open to traffic' 90).
sources.sample: OBJECTID 1 | HPC_ID 81 | Miles 23.639 | BltIntHPC 'Needing to be built or upgraded'
sources.notes: Long-range corridors (I-11, I-14, I-27, I-49, I-57, I-69, I-73, I-74, I-87 etc. in Prop_IntN; HPC_ID = High Priority Corridor number). Tells where upgrades to interstate standard, and so widening and new alignment, are coming; no project schedule or cost. No state/county attribute. Last edited 2025-08.

sources.name: USDOT Build America Bureau grant programs (IFAC, Regional Infrastructure Accelerators, Rural and Tribal Assistance, Reconnecting Communities Institute, Thriving Communities)
sources.authority: USDOT Build America Bureau (recipients: cities, counties, tribes, airports, state agencies)
sources.planned_filter: status LIKE '%ctive%' (Active 362; Complete 68; Closed 1). These are pre-development and planning grants, so every active record is a project not yet built.
sources.sample: Rural and Tribal Assistance Pilot Program (RTA) | Round 1 (FY 2023) | Bois Forte Band of Chippewa | Minnesota | 175000 | 'Pathway to Safety: Envisioning a Resilient Secondary Evacuation Route for Nett Lake' | Nett Lake | Active
sources.notes: Early-warning value: feasibility and P3 pre-development money for projects (new roads, terminals, transit facilities) that reach acquisition years later. Fields also recipient, state, latitude, longitude. Last edited 2026-08.

sources.name: CBP Smart Wall Map - border barrier Project_Alignments
sources.authority: US Customs and Border Protection (DHS); federal condemnation through DOJ under the Declaration of Taking Act
sources.planned_filter: Status_1 IN ('Awarded','Under Construction') (Awarded 13, Under Construction 61, Completed 17). 'Awarded' = contract let, not yet built.
sources.sample: SDC Smugglers Gulch Wall Project | San Diego Smugglers Gulch Gap Project | Primary Border Wall System | Completed | San Diego Sector | CA | 0.1 mi | San Diego County
sources.notes: The data layer behind CBP's public map at https://www.cbp.gov/border-security/along-us-borders/smart-wall-map. By state: TX 50, AZ 20, NM 10, CA 11. County holds one or several county names ('Starr, Hidalgo, & Cameron County'). Also Sector, Station, Length_Miles, Start_Lat/Start_Lon/End_Lat/End_Lon, Status_2 (barrier design). Texas (Starr, Hidalgo, Cameron, Webb, Zapata, Maverick, Val Verde) is where the border is private land and takings happen. Last edited 2026-11. Layer 0 is existing barrier.

sources.name: FAST-41 / Federal Permitting Dashboard projects (third-party snapshot of Permitting.gov data)
sources.authority: Federal Permitting Improvement Steering Council and lead agencies (FHWA, FAA, FTA, FERC, BLM, USACE, DOE); hosted copy by an Esri staff account
sources.planned_filter: Project_Status IN ('Planned','In Progress','Paused') (Planned 28, In Progress 523, Paused 93; Complete 914, Cancelled 126, Class of Action Changed 58). Project_Sector IN ('Surface Transportation','Pipelines','Electricity Transmission','Aviation','Water Resources','Ports and Waterways') for takings-prone work.
sources.sample: 71536 | Bay Area Rapid Transit Silicon Valley Santa Clara Extension (SVSX) Phase II | Department of Transportation / Federal Transit Administration | DOT Projects | Complete | Surface Transportation / Public Transportation | San Jose, Santa Clara, CA | 4700000000 | sponsor Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority
sources.restrictions: Item description: 'DEMO ONLY ... not an authoritative source ... snapshot downloaded on July 13, 2026'. Underlying data is federal public data; the copy is unofficial and may be removed.
sources.notes: Only machine-readable copy found of the Permitting Dashboard; the official site permits.performance.gov returned HTTP 403 to a scripted client. Includes the DOT permitting-dashboard projects (1,094 surface transportation, 444 aviation) as well as FAST-41 covered projects. Fields also Project_Lead_Agency, Project_Lead_Agency_Bureau, Project_Category, Project_Location_State, Project_Location_City, Project_Location_Latitude/Longitude, Project_Sponsor, Project_Url (link to the official project page). Layer 1 (23,196 rows) repeats each project per permit action/milestone with Action_Type, Action_Status, Milestone_Target_Completion_Date - useful for 'EIS record of decision due' timing. Point is a city/county centroid, not a footprint. Static since 2026-07.

sources.name: EPA EIS Database (e-NEPA) - environmental impact statements filed, with state
sources.authority: US EPA Office of Federal Activities; lead agencies FHWA, USACE, FERC, BLM, FRA, FTA, FAA, Reclamation, DOE
sources.planned_filter: Document = 'Draft' (project still under review) or 'Final' with a recent Federal Register Date (decision imminent). commonSearch=openComment lists EISs with an open comment period (11 on 2026-11-17); also commonSearch=lastWeek, last30Published, last60Issued.
sources.sample: Lower Missouri River Basin Flood Risk and Resiliency Comprehensive Study (System Plan) & Integrated Programmatic Environmental Impact Statement | CEQ 20260141 | Final | FR date 11/13/2026 | U.S. Army Corps of Engineers | State 'Multi'
sources.notes: HTML table only, no JSON/CSV endpoint found; the first request answers 302 and sets a session cookie, so the client must keep cookies and follow redirects. Columns: Title, CEQ Number, Document, EPA Comment Letter Date, Federal Register Date, Unique Identification Number, Lead Agency, Federal Cooperating Agency(ies), State, Download Documents; detail page /cdx-enepa-II/public/action/eis/details?eisId=<id>. State only, no county. The page loads an ALTCHA challenge script for the advanced search form; the commonSearch links worked without it. The same weekly lists are available as structured documents from the Federal Register API (EPA 'Environmental Impact Statements; Notice of Availability').

sources.name: BLM major transmission line right-of-way layers (TransWest Express, Gateway South, Gateway West, Boardman to Hemingway, SunZia, Southline, Ten West Link and newer solar-mapper lines)
sources.authority: Bureau of Land Management (ROW grants on federal land; the utility condemns the private segments under state law)
sources.planned_filter: One layer per project, no status field: layers 2 Boardman to Hemingway (68), 3 Gateway South (49), 4 Southline (31 polygons), 5 SunZia (53), 6 TransWest Express (145), 7 Gateway West. Check each project's construction state separately (several are now built or under construction).
sources.sample: Layer 6 TransWest Express: layer 'Northern Ground Electrode Centerline' | state Wyoming | county Carbon
sources.notes: Schemas differ by layer and are thin (linkno, miles, type, state, county where present). Index of the major lines with links to per-project services: https://services1.arcgis.com/KbxwQRRfWyEYLgp4/arcgis/rest/services/BLM_Natl_Major_TLines_For_Search_Line/FeatureServer/0 (4 rows, field hublink). Newer proposals (Southwest Intertie Project, Transcanyon Cross-Tie, North Plains Connector, Western Bounty segments 1-3) are layers 5-11 of https://services1.arcgis.com/KbxwQRRfWyEYLgp4/arcgis/rest/services/BLM_Natl_Solar_Mapper/FeatureServer. record_count is the sum of layers 2-6. Last edited 2022-2024. The states list is inferred from the named projects, not from an attribute.

sources.name: USACE Corps Project Notebook (all Civil Works projects, points and areas)
sources.authority: US Army Corps of Engineers Civil Works (flood risk, navigation, ecosystem; local sponsors acquire the land, easements and rights-of-way)
sources.planned_filter: None possible: no status, phase or date field. It is an inventory of authorised projects, built and unbuilt. Use only to geolocate a Corps project named in a Federal Register notice or EIS.
sources.sample: SALINE RIVER AR | PROJECTID 8528 | ORG_CD MVK (Vicksburg District)
sources.notes: Layer 1 = project areas (2,131 polygons). Fields also ORG_CD (district), P2_PROJECT_NUMBER, P2_PROJECT_NAME, PROGRAM_CODE, PROGRAM_NAME; many attributes are empty. The Corps' older 'Coastal Systems Portfolio Initiative' layer (https://services7.arcgis.com/n1YM8pTrFmm7L4hs/arcgis/rest/services/USACE_Coastal_Systems_Portfolio_Initiative/FeatureServer, 5 layers, fields SDSFEATURENAME, SDSFEATUREDESCRIPTION, STATE, PHASE with values such as 'Study', LABEL 'UNCONSTRUCTED') does carry a phase but was last updated 2017-2019.

unverified.reason: Responds (485 points) but last edited 2023-04, describes work on existing federal facilities (relay houses, switchyards), no status or location fields beyond Region/Office. No planned-project dataset with land acquisition found.

unverified.reason: Page loads as a JavaScript application; data endpoint not identified or tested.

unverified.reason: EDW service list read; no PALS/NEPA project layer in it. BLM ePlanning has no public REST folder (gis.blm.gov 'eplanning' folder 404). Projects on federal land seldom involve private takings, so not pursued further.

unverified.reason: No dataset found; only individual Federal Register notices.

summary: 13 national/federal sources verified by live requests on 2026-11-17 (2 open APIs, 1 Excel workbook, 1 HTML database, 9 ArcGIS layers). All 50 states are covered by USAspending (grant-level, with county, explicit 'right-of-way acquisition'/'acquire land' text), the Federal Register API (FERC pipeline certificates, EIS notices, STB, BLM), the EIA pipeline workbook (state level), USDOT discretionary grant awards, FRA Corridor ID lines, FHWA future interstates and the FAST-41/permitting snapshot. Regional: NEC rail inventory (MA-MD), CBP border wall projects (TX, AZ, NM, CA), BLM transmission ROW (western states). Not available as open data: the official Permitting Dashboard (403), FERC's own project lists and eLibrary (403/no API), FTA CIG project list (403), FHWA major projects list (removed), FAA planned airport projects (none published), OpenFEMA mitigation projects (dataset withdrawn), official DOE transmission corridor GIS, GSA site acquisitions. Weak points: most federal sources give state or point location rather than route geometry, and few carry a clean planned/complete status; the Corps layer has no status at all. data.transportation.gov (Socrata) was searched and holds no current project-level grant dataset beyond 2016 TIGER.
